item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 25/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong will be replaced by a southerly airstream gradually today. Showers will ease off over the coastal areas. The weather will be warm during the day, humid and foggy over the region during the weekend. A cold front is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Sunday. It will be cool and windy with thundery showers over the region early next week.

Date/Month: 25/03 (Friday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, force 6 offshore and occasionally force 8 on high ground at first. Becoming south force 4.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional showers. There will be coastal mist. Isolated thunderstorms at first. Showers will ease off gradually in the afternoon.
Temp range: 18 - 23 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High

Date/Month: 26/03 (Saturday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Coastal fog at first. A few showers and isolated thunderstorms later.
Temp range: 21 - 25 C
